inicio.titulo: A place to share your culinary world
inicio.saludo: Write about your cooking experiences and practices, share super secret culinary tips, or simply share your love of food.
inicio.vista_previa: We are waiting for you inside the community
inicio.ejemplo_1_mensaje: Crisp outside and soft inside. Best eaten warm, with a glass of milk.
inicio.ejemplo_2_mensaje: They came out uneven and addictive. Next time I promise to measure better.
inicio.ejemplo_3_mensaje: Coat them twice in breadcrumbs and let them rest for 10 minutes before baking.
inicio.ejemplo_4_mensaje: Tomatoes, garlic, basil and a lot of patience. That's how Sundays started at Grandma's.
inicio.invitacion_texto: Log in or create your account to post and see what everyone else shares.

registro.saludo: Join and start sharing your culinary experiences.
